request.prompt: A single glossy die-cut vinyl sticker of a Portuguese custard tart (pastel de nata) with a caramelized top. Flat vector illustration with soft, minimal shading and chunky rounded shapes, bold dark eggplant (#2b1b3a) outlines, a limited warm palette of cream (#faf9f6), warm marigold (#ffb320) and light brown, a thick clean white sticker border all around the shape, and a very subtle soft drop shadow. Centered, isolated on a transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no coins. Seen from a slight three-quarter angle above: a golden flaky pastry cup holding a glossy custard filling with a few dark caramelized spots. No plate, no cinnamon, no steam. Everything sits inside one single continuous white die-cut outline, with no separate floating pieces, sparkles or crumbs. The sticker fills most of the canvas with a small even margin. Style reference: the attached image is an approved sticker from the same set. Match its style exactly: the same bold eggplant outline weight, the same thick white die-cut border, the same flat colours with soft minimal shading, the same glossy highlight and the same very subtle drop shadow, at a similar size on the canvas. Use it only as a style guide: do not draw a tram or any part of it, and do not copy its colours where they differ from the palette above.
